title: Anthropic CEO confirms signed chip supply deals with Samsung and SK Hynix
reason: Wire-exclusive check (verification.md §2): the underlying claim -- Anthropic asked SK Hynix for chip-manufacturing supplies to build its own custom semiconductors -- traces to one origin: SK Group chairman Chey Tae-won's on-stage remarks with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at a San Francisco AI event, first reported by Bloomberg (2026-07-25). Fortune's and other outlets' text is the same Bloomberg wire content verbatim (identical 'Anthropic PBC' phrasing), not independent reporting. Business claims need >=2 independent Tier<=2 sources or a filing/document per §3; a company statement would also clear the bar, but neither Anthropic nor SK Hynix had issued its own confirming statement distinct from the chairman's quote as relayed by Bloomberg. RESOLVED 2026-07-27: Amodei himself, on record at a follow-up San Francisco summit tied to South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's visit (24 July 2026), confirmed Anthropic has signed supply agreements with both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. This is a named-executive company statement, independently reported by BusinessToday, Unique Times Magazine, and Korea JoongAng Daily, clearing the bar the chairman's wire-relayed quote had not. No chip type, value, or duration was disclosed by Amodei or found in any outlet checked.
watch: Any disclosure of chip type (ASIC vs GPU vs HBM), deal value, or timeline for Anthropic's specific agreements with Samsung and SK Hynix, which remain undisclosed as of publication
Any statement directly from Samsung or SK Hynix confirming or detailing their side of the Anthropic agreements
